descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S05 「医院服务端搜索：搜索时编辑、稀疏的页、另一个医生的病人」 Hospital server search: edits while searching, sparse pages, another physician's patient

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Hospital: search by name, by room, by MRN and by diagnosis each returns the correct matching patients, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 2；TFA-92581 AC 5）
  • U2 Hospital: sort by room, by name and by status each puts the list in the correct order.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 4；TFA-92581 AC 5）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Owner with four prefixed patients plus two unrelated rows; a second physician with an exact-match patient

When Page through rounding:listPage two rows at a time by room, name and status; search by name, MRN, diagnosis and room; then rename the patient, move its room and change its status; then remove it

Then Orders correct on every sort; empty scanned pages are followed instead of read as 'no match'; edits re-filter and re-sort at once; the other physician's match is never returned

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright API assertions on returned ids (U1, U2). The snf variant of this test is not used: it also asserts that a Nursing Home diagnosis search returns the resident, which AC 3 forbids; S06 replaces it. Needs precondition P1: without it the test fails with 'Run migrations:backfillPatientLists…' and is reported broken (env), not Fail

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both (paging and edit legs) / local (other-physician leg) 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
